product: Advantage Plus ELITE Hospital Indemnity Insurance

source_marking: FOR AGENT USE ONLY - internal reference, not for distribution

guaranteed_issue.note: Medical questions do NOT need to be answered if applicant is age 64.5 up to (but not including) 75 as of the application date, REGARDLESS of health. Exception: if applying for the Cancer rider, medical questions must be answered regardless of age.
guaranteed_issue.utah_note: UT: not Guaranteed Issue between age 64.5 and up to 70

medical_underwriting.rule: Final decision is based on answers to medical questions. If all medical questions are answered 'NO', applicant is eligible (subject to claim review if there is/was another GTL health policy).
medical_underwriting.cancer_rider_exception: Applicant must answer medical questions for the Cancer rider regardless of age, even in the GI window.

pre_existing_condition.definition: A sickness or injury (disclosed or not) for which medical care, treatment, diagnosis, or advice was received or recommended within the 6 months immediately prior to the effective date; or symptoms that would cause an ordinarily prudent person to seek diagnosis/care/treatment within that 6-month window. Includes taking prescription drugs/medicines.
pre_existing_condition.coverage_trigger: Pre-existing conditions are covered once the loss begins more than 6 months after the effective date.

state_exceptions.NC: No pre-existing condition limitation at all.
state_exceptions.note: Pre-ex period may differ by state; still applies during the Guaranteed Issue window.

application_rules.note_staleness: If the application is over 31 days old when received by GTL, a new currently-dated application is required.
application_rules.note_effective_date: Effective date cannot be more than 90 days from the application date, and cannot be prior to the application date.
application_rules.spouse_policy_fee: If both spouses apply for coverage, a separate annual policy fee is required for each.
application_rules.agent_requirement: Agent must be health-licensed and use the state-approved application for the state of the applicant's permanent residency.

policy_changes.benefit_increase_or_new_rider: Requires a new completed application (e-App, Agent Portal, or paper), subject to evidence of insurability.
policy_changes.cancel_rewrite_trigger: Changing the benefit period (increasing or decreasing) is treated as a cancel/rewrite: old policy terminated as of paid-to-date, new policy issued as of that same paid-to-date. Commissions paid on a renewal basis. Pre-existing waiting period and contestability period restart.
policy_changes.replacement_of_older_plan: Allowed subject to underwriting approval; commissions on the new policy paid on a renewal basis.
policy_changes.adding_dental_vision: Guaranteed Issue, can be added to an existing policy by calling GTL New Business (1-800-635-1993) or submitting the Dental/Vision Rider Addition Form.
policy_changes.rider_only_addition: New application required, sent to Underwriting for review. If approved, rider added as of the next paid-due date (or next month if on direct billing). No new policy is issued.

cross_product_overlap_limits.note: Applies across GTL and UNL products combined, not just within Advantage Plus Elite.

base_hospital_confinement.note: Applicant can have an additional $300/day Accident & Sickness Hospitalization rider under the Short-Term Home Health Care (HHC) plan.

skilled_nursing_facility_rider.note: Not allowed if another existing product has similar benefits (no duplication). Max $300 only available on Advantage Plus Elite. Overlaps with Long-Term Care and Recover Cash/Recuperation Plus products.

dental_vision_rider.note: Not allowed in combination with any other GTL or UNL dental coverage.

guaranteed_purchase_option_rider.note: Available upon issue only. Can be removed but cannot be added back once removed. Advantage Plus Elite plans only.

state_specific_variances.CT: Own Dental/Vision Policy (separate, not a rider); No Cancer, Outpatient Therapy, Critical Accident, or Outpatient Surgical Riders.
state_specific_variances.KS: Own Dental/Vision Policy (separate); No Cancer, Skilled Nursing Home, or Outpatient Therapy Riders.
state_specific_variances.MD: No Dental/Vision or Skilled Nursing Home Option 2 (Days 21-100); No Waiting Periods.
state_specific_variances.MN: No Cancer, Dental/Vision, or Skilled Nursing Facility Riders.
state_specific_variances.PA: Special Initial Benefit Period of $15/day for the remainder of the 31-day period.
state_specific_variances.SD: No Short Duration Hospital Stay Benefit.
state_specific_variances.TX: Special Initial Benefit Period of $15/day for the remainder of the 31-day period. No waiting period on Critical Accident rider (vs. 30 days standard).
state_specific_variances.UT: Not Guaranteed Issue between age 64.5 and up to 70.

methods: Mail to Guarantee Trust Life, Attn: New Business, 1275 Milwaukee Ave, Glenview, IL 60025
new_business_submission.voice_verification_required_when: Client is not present to sign, or unable to use the digital/text-to-sign signature feature. NOT required if applicant can digitally or hand sign.
new_business_submission.voice_verification_who: Only the insured applicant(s) can complete it - not the agent, POA, or anyone else. One call covers both spouses if applying jointly. Children do not need to complete it.
